prose: Sophie Fletcher returns to pick up where we left off in our recent InnerVerse episode covering the basics of Human Design. Joining us is her partner-in-life Yerasimos Stilianessis of Here For The Truth Podcast. With the deep experience and knowledge of somatic psychology and related philosophies that these two possess, you'll want to tune in live to chime in with your questions!
